title: We buy long
body: We go back to the same farms year after year, at prices agreed before the harvest. It costs more and it makes the coffee better, in that order.

title: We roast small
body: Twelve kilos at a time, twice a week, on a drum we can hear. Nothing leaves the roastery more than nine days old.

title: We tell you what's in it
body: Farm, altitude, process, roast date — printed on the bag and written on the board. If we can't tell you, we didn't buy it.
